categories.name: STX.CITY Ecosystem
categories.content: STX.CITY Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via STX.CITY.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Olympus Pro Ecosystem
categories.content: Olympus Pro designed to provide liquidity management solutions for DeFi protocols. They offers a service called "bonds-as-a-service," which allows protocols to own their liquidity by offering discounted OHM tokens in exchange for liquidity provider (LP) tokens. This helps protocols to reduce their reliance on liquidity mining incentives and gain more control over their liquidity.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: Celebrity-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by celebrity.

categories.name: Parody Meme
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by the names of well-known brands, individuals, or cultural icons.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: NFTStrategy Ecosystem
categories.content: NFTStrategy is an automated protocol that converts crypto trading fees into buying and selling floor NFTs, creating a self-sustaining value loop for NFT collections.

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem
categories.content: Sun Pump Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via sunpump.meme.

categories.name: NFT Strategy Flywheel
categories.content: The NFT Strategy Flywheel is a DeFi-NFT hybrid model that automates NFT accumulation and token burning using trading fees to drive continuous buy pressure and value accrual for token holders.

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: BONK.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: LetsBONK.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via letsbonk.fun.

categories.name: MMO
categories.content: Online games that host large numbers of players.

categories.name: BackedFi xStocks Ecosystem
categories.content: xStocks refers to the tokenized stocks and ETFs issued by BackedFi.

categories.name: Binance Wallet IDO
categories.content: Tokens and coins launched on Binance Wallet IDO.

categories.name: BTCfi Protocol
categories.content: BTCfi Protocol refers to DeFi protocols built on or around the Bitcoin ecosystem. It aims to bring DeFi activities such as lending, borrowing, and yield farming to Bitcoin holders.

categories.name: Racing Games
categories.content: Racing game involves competing in races with various vehicles. These games can range from realistic simulations to arcade-style fast-paced action.

categories.name: TRON Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the TRON network.
